newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off 0.14 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off 0.14 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.14 percent to close at 1.0486 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market after the Central Bank set a weaker mini-band for the currency of 1.0485 to 1.0535 per dollar, dealers said.
The previous mini-band was set last Thursday between 1.0470 and 1.0520 reais to the dollar.
Late in the day, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0485 real per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Thursday surplus of $100 million.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real fell 0.09 percent to end at 1.0542 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.19 percent to close at 1.075 per greenback.
